description: Returns what was recorded since a date (default 7 days, up to 90): SEC filings accepted, figures a company restated, technical signals and ownership declarations. By default (`highlights`) ranked by materiality, repeats grouped; `detail: 'events'` is the raw list, newest first. With `symbol`, one company: a 13F row then says what that manager did of it (`quarterMove`). Price moves are not events here (see get_company). When `complete` is false, pass `next.until` as `until` for the page before; `howToRead` in the answer explains each row. Use it for a daily or weekly brief, or when the user asks what changed.

detail.description: 'highlights' (default): ranked, grouped summary of the window. 'events': the raw list, newest first.

limit.description: Highlights: rows to return (default 40, max 100). Events: events to return (default 50, max 200).

since.description: ISO date or timestamp to look back from (default: 7 days ago). At most 90 days back: an older date is moved to that limit and `window.windowClamped` says so.

symbol.description: Restrict to one ticker. Omit for the whole universe.

until.description: ISO date or timestamp to read up to, included (default: now). Pass the previous answer's `next.until` to read the next page.

name: what_changed
title: Events since a date
